projects.name: Project 2
details: Work Area: Liquidity Management, Application and platform Upgrade
• Led JAD workshops to baseline requirements across Interest Optimisation, Sweep Transfers, Notional/Physical Pooling,
and Intercompany Loan Models in multi-entity banking environments.
• Produced BRDs, FRDs, and INVEST-compliant User Stories; conducted sign-off sessions and traceability audits to maintain scope integrity across stakeholder groups.
• Applied MoSCoW and value-stream mapping to prioritise capabilities; delivered As-Is/To-Be BPMN models and change
impact assessments to drive Operations and Testing adoption.
• Tracked defects in JIRA and facilitated RCA with engineering teams, ensuring closure within agreed SLAs.
• Leveraged AI tooling to generate RTMs, Acceptance Criteria, and test artefacts achieving 100% bi-directional
traceability with significantly reduced manual effort.
• Operated as embedded BA across Agile ceremonies, applied WSJF prioritisation to improve sprint velocity and manage
scope creep.
• Governed release activities including CIA, regression scoping, RAID log maintenance, BVT coordination, and executive
status reporting.

projects.name: Project 1
details: Work Area: Payments Initiation channels, Payments flow
• Elicited and baselined requirements for domestic and cross-border payment flows (ACH, RTGS, NEFT, BKT, TT,
CHEQUE, multi-currency) across GPP and core banking; formalised in BABOK-aligned BRDs and FSDs.
• Produced swimlane diagrams and BPMN maps across GPP, GCP, and PTM to close STP gaps and establish full
payment channel traceability.
• Decomposed Epics into Gherkin-formatted User Stories, led Product Owner sign-off to lock scope and minimise
late-cycle change.
• Executed Oracle SQL queries to trace payment status transitions, validate data integrity, and generate
evidence-based stakeholder reports.
• Managed JIRA defect logs and chaired RCA sessions, secured stakeholder-confirmed resolution within defined SLAs.
• Defined requirements and acceptance criteria for Automation Anywhere BOT workflows, validated bot behaviour
across regression and data integrity cycles.
• Owned full UAT lifecycle in strategy, entry/exit criteria, defect triage, and sign-off, produced Release Summary
Reports for governance forums.
• Maintained RTM with end-to-end traceability from business objectives to UAT sign-off, supplied regulatory
coverage evidence with zero gaps.
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Jan 2019 – Nov 2022

projects.name: Corporate Banking – ISO 20022 APAC Migration (CBPR+)
details: Work Area: ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, CBPR+, Cross-Border Payments
• Tested ISO 20022 migration for cross-border payments (CBPR+) including MT–MX and MX–MT message format
conversions using Volpay and Postman.
• Validated SWIFT MT and MX message formats (pain, pacs, camt) in E2E payment flows integrating GPP Fusion, FTI,
SWIFT Web Portal, and BigData platforms.
• Executed complex payment test scenarios covering domestic and cross-border transactions — ACH, international wire
transfers, RTGS, multi-currency, BKT, NEFT, CHEQUE, SEPA.
• Designed comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases from functional requirements and system
architecture documentation.
• Acted as primary testing point of contact for facilitators, executors, and validators; coordinated release control and
effort estimation.
• Maintained 100% business coverage through defect creation, retesting, and tracking to closure.

projects.name: Corporate Banking – Payment & Service Insights (Real-Time Payments Visibility)
details: Work Area: Cross-Border & Domestic Funds Transfer, ACH, SEPA, Instant Payments, Return of Funds
• Orchestrated comprehensive UAT testing for multi-regional payment systems (NAM, EMEA, APAC) covering real-time
payment visibility and on-demand payment action capabilities.
• Managed end-to-end transaction lifecycle testing through GPP Fusion, BigData ingestion, and Core Banking Systems.
• Led cross-functional validation of payment gateway capabilities for credit/debit transactions, bank transfers, ACH,
SEPA, Instant Payments, and Return of Funds.
• Performed GPP database querying (Oracle DB) to trace transaction states, validate payment processing, and
investigate defects.
• Designed test strategies and created test plans and test cases aligned to user stories; analysed execution results and
logs for functional quality assurance.
• Executed Production Verification Testing (PVT) post-deployment ensuring zero leakage to production.
• Collaborated with Product Owners, developers, and vendors to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities, and ensure
delivery quality.
